scientific_integrity: All formulas are stated with their exact domain and demonstrated by an algebraic proof, supplemented by exhaustive exact-integer checks only on finite electorates. Uninspected specialist treatments could contain equivalent statements.
scientific_limitations: Strict complete preferences among exactly three labeled alternatives; a strict Condorcet winner excludes pairwise ties. The conditional distribution assumes independent uniform ordered rankings given the matrix. No higher-candidate conclusion, independence assessment, or claim of exhaustive literature uniqueness.
title: Exact Condorcet ambiguity from three-candidate position matrices
